x: We extend a cordial welcome to those new members who have joined us since our last issue and hope that they will not hesitate to contact any of our officials should they require any advice. Michael J.
John Bicourt and Adrian Major are, of course, far and away the leading pair but we have a good prospect in new member Michael Baker from Battersea College of Technology.
James Rimmer and a new member,Michael Baker,were our other scorers in 100th and 133rd places respectively. Little change took place on the second lap.

Our other two scorers were Mike Baker, whose 195th place was a good effort in his first year of running, and Jim Rimmer who, when ahead of Baker, had two heavy falls that cost him 100 places in half a mile.

Dabbs's superior strength had the edge on young Major and both dropped Trevor Hart. Bill Dance (11th) and Junior Michael Baker (39th) both ran particularly well and we should be seeing a lot more of these two.
